name: Aspire
summary: All-in-one finance stack for global businesses: multi-currency accounts (30+ currencies), corporate cards with 1.2% cashback, expense management, bill pay, payments and payroll — with AI fraud detection and multi-admin approval workflows.
best_for: startups and SMBs that want an all-in-one business account with $0 monthly fees and built-in spend management
skip_if: you need a traditional bank relationship, lending, or coverage in a region Aspire doesn't serve — check availability first
honest_knock: It's a fintech account (strongest in Southeast Asia), not a full bank — great for keeping fixed costs near zero on mostly-domestic activity, but confirm it supports your country and currencies before you build your finances around it.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-10-02 against the vendor's own pricing page) SGD $0 monthly fee on Basic, no minimum balance and no deposit to open. You pay per use: FX from 0.23% to send, from 0.34% to receive and from 0.22% for instant conversion, inbound SWIFT SGD $35 for SGD accounts or USD $8 for others, outbound SWIFT USD $15 for SHA and USD $30 for OURS. Premium is SGD $15/month and zeroes the FX margin on the first SGD $13,000 of conversions a month, after which the same from-0.23% applies.

compare_with.name: Wise Business or a local business bank
